spooldir.description: Directory where user mailboxes (mbox or maildir) are stored

daemon_user.description: System user the POP3 daemon runs as (for privilege dropping)

daemon_group.description: System group the POP3 daemon runs as (for privilege dropping)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before disconnecting a client

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure connections

tls_certfile.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format)

tls_keyfile.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format)

allowed_hosts.description: List of permitted client hosts (leave empty to allow all)

denied_hosts.description: List of blocked client hosts (leave empty to deny none)

chroot_enabled.description: Enable chroot jail for enhanced security

chroot_dir.description: Root directory for the chroot jail (must be populated)

top_enabled.description: Enable the POP3 TOP command (allows partial message retrieval)

uidl_enabled.description: Enable the POP3 UIDL command (unique message identifiers)

sasl_enabled.description: Enable SASL authentication (e.g., for PLAIN/LOGIN over TLS)

sasl_db_path.description: Path to SASL password database file

log_failed.description: Log failed login attempts (useful for security auditing)

max_failed_attempts.description: Maximum failed login attempts before locking the account

lockout_duration.description: Seconds to lock out an account after max failed attempts

maildir_format.description: Use Maildir format (one file per message) instead of mbox (one file per mailbox)
